statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93226
The service is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The monitor was ordered to evaluate for underlying cardiac arrhythmias and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The denial reason code is CO-22
The payer letter requests the primary insurer's Explanation of Benefits for further processing
